decision: Record a low-priority corrected-energy candidate for dicyanoacetylene; the 1963 combustion correction supports reassessing the older JANAF anchor.
follow_up: Build a corrected-energy retained-thermal control using an explicitly chosen balanced anchor (NASA +4.358965 kJ/mol relative to JANAF is the available numerical control), and compare a separate NASA-thermal control. Preserve the fit residual and run fixed-network substitution before adoption. The small hot-grid abundance places this after the more important candidates.
